Intricate Dot Mandala 04 Coloring Page

A free printable intricate mandala with 24-fold symmetry and about 680 spaces to color.

Download and print

PDF, US LetterPDF, A4

Print at 100 percent scale. The lines print about 0.4 mm wide, best with fine-tip markers, gel pens or sharp colored pencils.

What's in it

From the center out: 24 double-lined teardrops, 48 teardrops, a zigzag band, 24 hearts, 24 dots, 48 teardrops, 24 triple-lined arches, 24 dots, 48 triple-lined arches, 48 dots and 48 triple-lined dots, inside a plain outer ring.

Change it first

Open it in the maker to change the symmetry, thicken the lines or add your own drawing.

Edit this mandala
